_comment: V.A.P.E. MCP server registry. VAPE is an MCP host (skillforge/mcp_client.py) that spawns any of these over stdio, lazily per call, then tears them down (no daemons = no idle compute). Keyless servers with a present runtime work today; keyed community servers activate the instant their env var is set (no code change). Package sources verified against npm/PyPI 2026-07-01. Servers whose runtime is absent report available=false rather than failing.

vape.purpose: V.A.P.E.'s own detective tools (investigate, scan, wallet trace, contract source, DefiLlama intel, bounty radar, memory, hacks, fear/greed, web research crawler)

filesystem.purpose: Sandboxed read/write to allow-listed dirs (contracts, reports, tools)

memory.purpose: Knowledge-graph persistent memory (companion to Central Memory)

sequential-thinking.purpose: Structured step-by-step reasoning for complex investigations

fetch.purpose: LLM-optimized web content fetching (protocols, CVEs, docs)
fetch.runtime_note: needs uvx (pip install uv) or: pipx run mcp-server-fetch

git.purpose: Repo inspection: diffs, history, blame (analyze targets or own code)

sqlite.purpose: Structured queries over VAPE's derived memory DB

brave-search.purpose: Brave web/news search — bounty discovery, protocol/CVE research

tavily.purpose: Tavily AI search + extract — high-signal research for agents

firecrawl.purpose: Firecrawl deep crawl/scrape/extract — protocol docs, bounty pages

apify.purpose: Apify actors — structured web data extraction at scale

brightdata.purpose: Bright Data Web MCP — robust unblockable web access/scraping

github.purpose: Richer GitHub ops than the custom wrapper (issues, PRs, search)
